_meta.source: Real first appointment, Pocket recorder export (SPEAKER_00: inline labels, no timestamps).
notes: Hand-verified against the transcript line by line.
This fixture exists because every other fixture is the Otter shape — a speaker
line with a timestamp, then the utterance. The recorder in actual use emits
inline 'SPEAKER_00: text' with no timestamps, and that format silently parsed
as ONE turn for the whole session while reporting 100% attribution coverage.
The golden set never covered the format that was broken, which is why it stayed
broken. Keep a no-timestamp fixture here.
Diarization is unreliable on purpose: the speaker label drifts across
SPEAKER_00..04 for the same two people, so role attribution must come from
`acceptable` items are neither rewarded nor penalised — defensible readings a
careful human could differ on. `expect_null` is the fabrication test: the
transcript never states these, so any value at all is a fabricated finding.
Gold strings are phrased close to the transcript on purpose: extraction is verbatim-ish, and summary phrasing scores a correct capture as both a miss and a false positive.

`stressors` is scored on its own, matched by category rather than position, and the SOURCE is graded separately from the category — finding "food" when the practitioner said "food, specifically dairy" is half an answer, and a source we supply that they never named is a fabrication.

Three causal assessments were added on 2026-08-19 after a live eval showed the extraction finding statements the gold set had simply omitted — all three name what a finding comes FROM, the class of statement this fixture now exists to protect. Verified against the transcript before adding.
